diesel-2026-11-09.title: US & Canada diesel prices: week of November 9
diesel-2026-11-09.desc: US diesel averaged $6.13 a gallon for the week of November 9, down 17¢ from the week before, according to the US Energy Information Administration. Highest: California at $7.90. Lowest: Lower Atlantic at $5.69.
